field.label: Shop Token (Frontend)
field.comment: Used in the browser to load the editor. Find it in the Printess account menu under API-Token.

field.label: Service Token (Backend / PDF Production)
field.comment: Used server-side to trigger production. Never expose this in the browser.

field.label: API URL
field.comment: Address of the Printess API. Leave blank for https://api.printess.com; only change this if Printess support asks you to.

field.label: Editor Theme
field.comment: Default theme for all Printess editors in this store. Can be overridden per product.

field.label: Editor Version
field.comment: Which build of the Printess editor to load, e.g. "nightly" for the current staging build. The "/v/" prefix is added automatically if you leave it out. Leave blank to load the current release version.

field.label: Print Settings
field.comment: Select the named print settings to use when producing PDFs. Options are loaded from your Printess account.

field.label: Hold Until Paid
field.comment: Wait until the order item is invoiced before sending it to production. Applies to all Printess items, including dropshipped ones.

field.label: Approve Before Production
field.comment: When enabled, Printess items wait on the order page until an admin approves them. Nothing is produced or shipped before that.

field.label: Production Status Updates
field.comment: How the shop learns that production finished and that dropship items shipped. Callbacks: Printess calls this store's own URL right away. If that URL is not publicly reachable over https (e.g. a local or test shop), the shop falls back to polling automatically. Polling: the shop checks Printess every few minutes.

field.label: Callback URL (override, for debugging)
field.comment: Leave empty on live shops — Printess then calls this store's own URL. Set it only when Printess can't reach that URL, e.g. a local shop behind an HTTP tunnel. Must be https with a public domain name (no IP addresses or localhost).

field.label: Send Shipment Email
field.comment: Email the customer the shipment confirmation with tracking information when the dropshipper reports an item as shipped.

field.label: Reproducing Dropship Orders
field.comment: Some dropshippers (e.g. Siteflow) refuse an order number they have received before. By default a reproduction is sent under the order number with a suffix. Alternatively you can be asked each time whether to duplicate the order instead: the copy gets a new order number, is free for the customer (a discount line makes the total 0) and carries a message the customer sees.

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Enable expiry reminders and removal of expired Printess projects.

field.label: Project Retention Days
field.comment: Number of days a saved project is retained before being deleted. Should align with the save-token expiry set in your Printess account settings.

field.label: Remind to Order After Days
field.comment: Send an order reminder email this many days after a project is saved without being ordered. Leave blank to disable order reminders entirely. Minimum 1 day.

field.label: Removal Reminder Before Days
field.comment: Send a project deletion warning email this many days before the project expires. Leave blank to disable removal reminders entirely. Minimum 1 day.

field.label: Remind to Order Email Template
field.comment: Email template sent to customers who have a saved project but have not yet placed an order.

field.label: Removal Reminder Email Template
field.comment: Email template sent to customers warning that their saved project is about to be permanently deleted.

field.label: Email Send Batch Limit
field.comment: Maximum reminders sent by each cron run.
